items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: In 1930 Adelaide Hall came to Omaha, Nebraska... She had three pianists... Here's a woman, Adelaide Hall, came up with 3 pianists.

ctx.x: saxophone and here comes Coleman Hawkins, so forget it, so I switched to the piano. In 1930 Adelaide Hall came to Omaha, Nebraska. By that time I had migrated because I was going to continue my education, I thought, because I was with a band at the time called Skeet Morgan and R. C. Hicks and their Dixie Ramblers. We found ourselves out at Chillicothe, Missouri -
What were you playing at that time? Were you playing drums then?
